text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
In this podcast,
we have real conversations in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 我们用简单的英语进行真实对话，帮助你学习英语。
zh_hant: 我們用簡單的英語進行真實對話，幫助你學習英語。

text: I'm Neil.
And I'm Georgie.
Remember, you can watch a video version of this podcast
zh: 记住，你可以在我们的网站上观看这档播客的视频版本，
zh_hant: 記住，你可以在我們的網站上觀看這檔播客的影片版本，

text: on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
How are you today, Georgie?
I'm very well, thank you, today, Neil.
zh: 我今天很好，谢谢你，尼尔。
zh_hant: 我今天很好，謝謝你，尼爾。

text: How are you?
I'm OK.
I've got one or two little worries .
Have you?
Well, that's interesting because we are talking about worries today
zh: 嗯，这挺有意思的，因为我们今天在这期播客里正好要聊“担心”这个话题。
zh_hant: 嗯，這挺有意思的，因為我們今天在這期播客里正好要聊“擔心”這個話題。

text: in this podcast.
are problems that make you feel upset or scared.
zh: “worries”指的是让你感到不安或害怕的问题。
zh_hant: “worries”指的是讓你感到不安或害怕的問題。

text: So shall we start the conversation?
Let's do it.
So, Neil, you said you've got a couple of little worries .
zh: 尼尔，你说你有一两件小烦心事。
zh_hant: 尼爾，你說你有一兩件小煩心事。

text: Do you want to share them?
Yeah.
I think, I think when you have kids,
zh: 我觉得，我觉得当你有了孩子以后，
zh_hant: 我覺得，我覺得當你有了孩子以後，

text: you're kind of slightly worried all the time.
And yesterday, my son got hurt playing cricket.
zh: 昨天，我儿子打板球的时候受伤了。
zh_hant: 昨天，我兒子打板球的時候受傷了。

text: And so this morning,
I just wanted to make sure
he was feeling OK before he went to school.
And how was he this morning?
zh: 那他今天早上怎么样了？
zh_hant: 那他今天早上怎麼樣了？

text: He seemed OK.
Yeah, he seemed a bit bruised.
Oh, no.
An injury to the knee or something?
Shoulder.
Ouch.
And arm.
Gosh.
Yeah.
And do you...
Are you someone that worries a lot?
zh: 你是那种容易担心的人吗？
zh_hant: 你是那種容易擔心的人嗎？

text: No, not really.
Sometimes, but I think
there's lots of stuff that you can worry about.
zh: 值得担心的事情太多了。
zh_hant: 值得擔心的事情太多了。

text: And if you, if you worry
about all of it,
can really affect you badly.
zh: 真的会对你造成很大的负面影响。
zh_hant: 真的會對你造成很大的負面影響。

text: So I try, I know it's difficult sometimes,
zh: 所以我尽量，我知道有时候很难做到，
zh_hant: 所以我儘量，我知道有時候很難做到，

text: not to worry too much about things that aren't so important.
zh: 不去为那些不太重要的事情过分担心。
zh_hant: 不去為那些不太重要的事情過分擔心。

text: My thing is that worrying about a problem
zh: 我的想法是，担心一个问题
zh_hant: 我的想法是，擔心一個問題

text: or a thing
doesn't actually help.
So I'm in general,
I'm a person that doesn't worry too much.
zh: 我是一个不太爱担心的人。
zh_hant: 我是一個不太愛擔心的人。

text: I kind of just think whatever happens, happens.
zh: 我基本上就是想，该发生的事情总会发生。
zh_hant: 我基本上就是想，該發生的事情總會發生。

text: So I'm generally quite chilled
zh: 所以我总体上挺淡定的，
zh_hant: 所以我總體上挺淡定的，

text: and relaxed.
That's true.
That's a very healthy attitude probably.
zh: 这可能是一种很健康的心态。
zh_hant: 這可能是一種很健康的心態。

text: So I don't tend to worry a lot.
But you, you worry a little bit because you have kids.
zh: 不过你呢，因为有孩子，你会有点担心。
zh_hant: 不過你呢，因為有孩子，你會有點擔心。

text: What kinds of things do you do to make yourself feel more relaxed?
zh: 你会做些什么让自己放松一点呢？
zh_hant: 你會做些什麼讓自己放鬆一點呢？

text: Well, I think, like you said,
zh: 嗯，我觉得，就像你说的那样，
zh_hant: 嗯，我覺得，就像你說的那樣，

text: one useful thing to do could be to try
zh: 一个有用的办法可能是尽量
zh_hant: 一個有用的辦法可能是儘量

text: to be rational.
So to think that what you're worried
about probably
isn't that important or,
likely to happen.
But, yeah.
So you're quite chilled , as you said.
zh: 就像你说的，你挺淡定的。
zh_hant: 就像你說的，你挺淡定的。

text: That must be nice for your friends.
zh: 这对你的朋友们来说一定很好。
zh_hant: 這對你的朋友們來說一定很好。

text: Yes.
And if you have, like you said, a friend who's,
zh: 如果，就像你说的，有个朋友
zh_hant: 如果，就像你說的，有個朋友

text: who worries about everything, how do you help them?
zh: 对什么都担心，你会怎么帮他？
zh_hant: 對什麼都擔心，你會怎麼幫他？

text: Finding maybe a distraction.
zh: 也许可以找点事情分散注意力。
zh_hant: 也許可以找點事情分散注意力。

text: Like something that makes you feel good.
zh: 做一些能让你感觉良好的事情。
zh_hant: 做一些能讓你感覺良好的事情。

text: Like a TV programme that you love.
zh: 比如你喜欢的一档电视节目。
zh_hant: 比如你喜歡的一檔電視節目。

text: Or seeing friends, that love you,
zh: 或者去见那些爱你的朋友，
zh_hant: 或者去見那些愛你的朋友，

text: that can make you feel more relaxed.
zh: 这也能让你感觉更放松。
zh_hant: 這也能讓你感覺更放鬆。

text: Mindfulness techniques as well.
zh: 还有正念练习之类的方法。
zh_hant: 還有正念練習之類的方法。

text: Maybe jigsaws.
I've talked about puzzles in the past.
zh: 我以前也提到过拼图这类活动。
zh_hant: 我以前也提到過拼圖這類活動。

text: Do you have any other tips?
No. These are all very good ideas.
zh: 没有了，这些都是很好的建议。
zh_hant: 沒有了，這些都是很好的建議。

text: Thank you.
Yeah.
I think it can be useful to have something that distracts you.
zh: 我觉得有件事能分散注意力会很有用。
zh_hant: 我覺得有件事能分散注意力會很有用。

text: Like maybe drawing, listening to music, playing an instrument
zh: 比如画画、听音乐、演奏乐器，
zh_hant: 比如畫畫、聽音樂、演奏樂器，

text: can help.
Something that just kind of takes that time away.
zh: 就是那种能让你暂时抽离出来的事情。
zh_hant: 就是那種能讓你暫時抽離出來的事情。

text: It takes your mind off the the stress.
zh: 能让你把注意力从压力上移开。
zh_hant: 能讓你把注意力從壓力上移開。

text: Yeah. OK.
Let's recap the vocabulary we heard during the conversation,
zh: 我们来回顾一下对话中出现的词汇，
zh_hant: 我們來回顧一下對話中出現的詞彙，

text: starting with worry .
A worry is a problem that makes you feel upset or scared,
zh: worry指的是让你感到不安或害怕的问题，
zh_hant: worry指的是讓你感到不安或害怕的問題，

text: and worry is also a verb.
So for example, I worry about my kids.
zh: 比如说，我会为我的孩子担心（I worry about my kids）。
zh_hant: 比如說，我會為我的孩子擔心（I worry about my kids）。

text: Yes, and we also use the adjective worried
zh: 是的，我们还会用形容词worried
zh_hant: 是的，我們還會用形容詞worried

text: to describe that feeling of being scared or upset about something.
zh: 来描述那种因为某事而感到害怕或不安的感觉。
zh_hant: 來描述那種因為某事而感到害怕或不安的感覺。

text: For example, I'm worried about climate change.
zh: 比如说，我很担心气候变化（I'm worried about climate change）。
zh_hant: 比如說，我很擔心氣候變化（I'm worried about climate change）。

text: And we heard the expression take your mind off something,
zh: 我们还听到了一个表达take your mind off something，
zh_hant: 我們還聽到了一個表達take your mind off something，

text: which means to do something to stop you worrying .
zh: 意思是做某件事来让自己不再担心。
zh_hant: 意思是做某件事來讓自己不再擔心。

text: For example, I play my guitar
to take my mind off my worries .
zh: 来让自己不去想那些烦心事。
zh_hant: 來讓自己不去想那些煩心事。

text: We also heard chilled , which is another word for relaxed
zh: 我们还听到了chilled这个词，它是relaxed（放松）
zh_hant: 我們還聽到了chilled這個詞，它是relaxed（放鬆）

text: or calm.
And it's quite an informal word.
zh: 是一个比较口语化、非正式的词。
zh_hant: 是一個比較口語化、非正式的詞。

text: Next time we'll
be talking about our brains.
See you then.
Goodbye.
